title: GUI Project Detail Auto Update
outcome_summary: All 5 work packages delivered a fully dynamic GUI project detail page for the ai-insights MCP server via periodic 5-second polling, a snapshot/diff classification engine, targeted compare-and-swap DOM patching, a render-scoped poll state machine, and flicker-free orchestrator runs section updates with scroll preservation. 100 new tests were added across 4 new test files against 1,339 total passing with zero regressions. The highest-priority follow-up identified is extracting a shared GUI test fixture module to resolve makeProject() helper divergence accumulating across 5+ test files.
